title: Gordon Cooper's 1957 craft landing on base

tellings.quote: He shared with us that in 1957 that uh he was on the base and they had a craft land physically land on the base.
And this saucer flew right over them and put down three little gear and landed out on the dry lake bed.
tellings.difference: Told by Cooper himself in a clip rather than secondhand by Foltz, and adds that the saucer flew over the crew and put down three landing gear.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about the 1957 craft that landed on the base's dry lake bed, as Gordon Cooper tells it.

as_told.title: Cooper clip: saucer lands on dry lake bed

plain: In 1957 a craft landed on an air base, according to the astronaut Gordon Cooper. In a clip shown on Michels's show he says the saucer "flew right over" a crew, "put down three little gear and landed out on the dry lake bed." A man named Charlie Foltz, who says Cooper told the story to him and others, repeats it in the same episode. If it is true, a trained test pilot who later became an astronaut saw an unknown craft touch down on a military base.
